title: Operating theater
summary: Digital request queue, double-booking-proof scheduling, live board, consumable scanning, one-click settlement & commission split.
markdown:
# Operating theater

1. **Provision** (Super Admin, once): `POST /ot/theaters {"code": "OT1", "name": "Main OT 1"}`.
2. **Request** (surgeon): `POST /ot/bookings {"patient_id", "procedure_name", "service_id"?, "booking_type": "Scheduled"}`
   → `Requested` (priority: CodeRed > Emergency > Scheduled).
   The patient from `GET /patients/search`, the service from `GET /finance/service-catalog?category=OT`, the primary
   surgeon from `GET /staff/lookup?license_type=PMDC` (default: the requesting surgeon).
3. **Schedule** (OT admin): `GET /ot/queue`, `GET /ot/calendar?start&end`, then
   `POST /ot/bookings/{id}/schedule {"ot_id", "scheduled_start", "duration_minutes", "procedure_price"?}`.
   The turnover buffer is added automatically; overlapping blocks are impossible (database exclusion
   constraint → `OT_DOUBLE_BOOKING`). The price is frozen once scheduled.
   Another surgeon from `GET /staff/lookup?license_type=PMDC`.
4. **Live board** (every terminal): `GET /ot/status-board` + `ot.status.updated` — 🟢 Available /
   🔴 In-Surgery / 🟡 Cleaning-Prep / ⚠ Emergency hold, "Appendectomy - Dr. Tariq", no patient names.
5. **Intra-op**: `POST /ot/bookings/{id}/start`; scan consumables
   `POST /ot/bookings/{id}/consumables {"barcode": "8964…", "qty": 2}` (pharmacy stock leaves FEFO; cost and
   retail are snapshotted); mistakes `POST /ot/consumables/{id}/reverse {"reason"}`;
   `POST /ot/bookings/{id}/complete-surgery` (→ Cleaning), `…/complete-cleaning` (→ Available).
   The clinical record of the operation runs alongside: the surgeon's pre-operative note, the pre-anaesthesia
   assessment, the safety checklist, the anaesthesia record, the operative note, recovery
   ([Surgical care](surgical-care.md)). The operation cannot be completed before the sign out of the checklist
   (`OT_CHECKLIST_INCOMPLETE`); a patient who had an anaesthetist is then in recovery.
   Without a barcode, the formulary item from `GET /drugs/search`.
6. **Post-op settlement** (one irreversible action):
   * `POST /ot/bookings/{id}/settlement-preview {"participants": [{"employee_id", "role_in_ot": "PrimarySurgeon"}, …]}`
     (the team named at the time out, `GET /ot/bookings/{id}/surgical-record` → `checklist`, is a good default; anyone
     else is picked with `GET /staff/lookup?q=`)
     → gross (procedure − discount + consumables), consumables cost, net profit, each commission with
     its basis ("30% of gross 120100"), hospital net. A person listed in two roles (for example primary and
     assistant surgeon) earns their contract's share once per role listed: the owner's rule (audit F-14). List a
     person in one role unless they really did both.
   * `POST /ot/bookings/{id}/finalize` (same body) — bills the patient (IPD running bill or a finalized
     OT invoice), records the settlement, accrues **regular staff** commissions for the next payroll and
     puts **visiting consultants** straight into the Accountant's AP queue ("Dr. Tariq - Appendectomy -
     Rs. 36,030"). All or nothing. Commissions above net profit → `OT_COMMISSION_CAP_EXCEEDED` unless
     `commission_cap_override_reason` is given (flagged for review). Twice → `OT_ALREADY_SETTLED`.
7. **Pay the consultant**: Accountant `POST /finance/ap/{ap_id}/settle {"method": "Cash"}` ("Settle Payment").

Contracts (one-time per consultant, Billing Admin; the consultant picked with `GET /staff/lookup?q=`): `POST /finance/consultant-contracts
{"employee_id", "rule_type": "PercentGross" | "PercentNet" | "FixedFee", "percentage" | "amount", "effective_from"}`.

Code Red with `needs_ot: true` places an `EmergencyHold` on the free theater with the longest window
(`ot.emergency_hold`); price it later during scheduling and start it directly.
